image_description: A collection of adhesive bandages (Band-Aids) and related first-aid items arranged on a white background. The central focus is a large, white bandage with red text reading 'BAND' (reversed/mirrored) and blue gibberish text below it. To the left, there is a small tube of ointment and two red patterned bandages. In the foreground, there are two standard beige flesh-toned bandages and a circular red, white, and blue emblem or sticker.
